vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 3.2.0

The skill bundle provides documentation and instructions for an AI agent to interact with the Agent Times news API (agenttimes.live). It defines several endpoints for semantic news search, trending topics, and category browsing using standard curl commands. The instructions are well-structured to guide an agent's decision-making process and do not contain any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news/search HTTP API (agenttimes.live); its declared requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with that purpose and it requests no credentials or unusual system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description advertise a news/search API and the SKILL.md only requires curl and documents HTTP endpoints on agenttimes.live. There are no unrelated binaries, env vars, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are concrete curl examples calling agenttimes.live endpoints (GET /ask, /trending, /news, POST /subscribe, etc.). They do not instruct reading local files, other env vars, or sending data to unrelated external hosts beyond the documented API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files; this is instruction-only. That minimizes on-disk risk—agent only needs an existing curl binary to make HTTP requests.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The API is described as usable without an API key for free endpoints; paid features are mentioned but no payment credentials are requested by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there is no request to persist configuration or modify other skills. The skill can be invoked normally by the agent but it does not request elevated or persistent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill simply calls a third-party HTTP API (agenttimes.live) using curl. Before installing, consider: (1) any queries you send will go to that external service—avoid sending sensitive secrets or PII in queries; (2) subscribing requires providing a webhook URL—only use webhook endpoints you control and avoid embedding auth tokens in the URL; (3) paid endpoints and micropayments are mentioned—confirm billing/payment flow outside the skill; and (4) verify the service's TLS, privacy, and retention policies if you rely on it for sensitive data. Otherwise the skill appears coherent and proportionate to its stated purpose.
